Source actions for pose or explicitly named equipment only: 짓밟기, 바퀴 칼날, 돌격 준비, 질주.

Do not copy their puppet anatomy, brass armor, face plates, smoke vents, or accessories into an enemy that is not described with those features. Preserve this exact enemy design, same compact composition, same relative proportions, palette, source equipment and pixel technique.
